conditions: The rule concerns conformance of a hosted environment if the draft implementation provides one.
limitations: The claim is limited to N3220 and does not supply a property of any freestanding implementation or the published edition.

triggers: Evidence correction, scope change, or contrary primary material.

statement: WG14 working draft N3220 makes provision of a hosted environment optional and applies the hosted-environment specifications when such an environment is present.
